card.name: Formal prose connectors before clauses
card.fires_on: Small connecting words (so, part, most, at, time, both) in old-fashioned or scholarly English prose, where a formal clause or phrase such as 'so as to', 'part of which' or 'most of them' follows.

modes.label: Formal connector words
modes.description: Short linking words in literary or archaic sentences that introduce a purpose or partitive phrase.

card.writes: It favors formal, archaic-sounding continuations such as 'thereof', 'duly', 'firstly' and 'favour', and disfavors dash-led interjections.
card.plain: It marks old-style formal writing where a small linking word is about to open a stiff, bookish phrase.
